words.engDef: the official written record of the meetings and discussions
words.example: The secretary took detailed minutes during the board meeting.

words.engDef: communication or cooperation which facilitates a close working relationship
words.example: She acts as a liaison between the marketing department and the design team.

words.engDef: an exact copy, especially of written or printed material
words.example: Please send a facsimile of the signed agreement to our headquarters.

words.engDef: an area allocated for one's work, as in an office
words.example: Employees are encouraged to keep their workspace clean and clutter-free.

words.engDef: a written message in business or diplomacy
words.example: The CEO issued a memorandum regarding the new remote work policy.

words.engDef: relating to office work, especially routine tasks
words.example: The administrative assistant is responsible for routine clerical tasks.

words.engDef: an individual's work area in an office, typically with a computer
words.example: Every new employee is assigned a modern workstation with dual monitors.

words.engDef: a small partitioned space in an office
words.example: She decorated her office cubicle with family photos and plants.

words.engDef: designed for efficiency and comfort in the working environment
words.example: The company purchased ergonomic office chairs to prevent back strain.

words.engDef: the practice of allocating office desks to workers when required
words.example: Hot-desking allows the firm to reduce overhead expenses and utilize space efficiently.

words.engDef: work from home using the internet and phone
words.example: Many modern software developers prefer to telecommute rather than travel to the office.

words.engDef: a system of working with starting/finishing times chosen by the employee
words.example: The introduction of flextime led to a noticeable boost in employee morale.

words.engDef: the minimum number of members that must be present at a meeting
words.example: We cannot proceed with the vote because we have not reached a quorum.

words.engDef: to break off a meeting with the intention of resuming it later
words.example: The chairperson decided to adjourn the annual meeting until next Thursday.

words.engDef: the authority to represent someone else, especially in voting
words.example: Shareholders who cannot attend the meeting can cast their votes by proxy.

words.engDef: the total number of people employed by a company
words.example: The company planned to reduce its headcount by ten percent to cut costs.

words.engDef: intentional reduction of the number of employees on a payroll
words.example: Corporate downsizing led to the merger of several regional departments.

words.engDef: the act of organizing the operational or ownership structure of a company
words.example: The firm underwent operational restructuring to improve its competitiveness.

words.engDef: excessive bureaucracy or adherence to rules and formalities
words.rootPrefix: red + tape (from tying documents with red ribbons)
words.example: We had to cut through a lot of red tape to secure the building permit.

words.engDef: a person who stands over or supervises a person or an activity
words.example: You should report any technical issues to your immediate supervisor.

words.engDef: a person who organizes many people or elements of a complex activity
words.example: The event coordinator is finalizing the catering and seating arrangements.

words.chinese: 業務海外外包，離岸外包
words.engDef: the practice of basing some of a company's processes or services overseas
words.example: Offshoring tech support helped the software corporation lower operational costs.

words.engDef: the transfer of business processes to a nearby country
words.example: The European retailer chose nearshoring in Poland to maintain quick supply lines.

words.chinese: 立即成套可用的，一站式的
words.engDef: complete and ready for immediate use, especially of a software or construction project
words.example: The consultancy provided a turnkey solution for our enterprise resource planning.

words.engDef: relating to an owner or ownership; protected by patent or copyright
words.example: The brand developed proprietary software that competitors cannot copy.

words.engDef: a business or person that carries out work for a main contractor
words.example: The plumbing subcontractor is installing the pipes on the third floor today.

words.engDef: an act of adjourning; a postponement of a meeting
words.example: The adjournment of the negotiation gave both sides time to reconsider.
